jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Defined Contribution & Retirement Income
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Pacific Life is investing in bright, agile, and diverse talent to contribute to our mission of innovating our business and creating a superior customer experience. We’re actively seeking a talented Senior Retirement Income Product Manager to join the Institutional Division in Newport Beach, CA, Omaha, NE, or Charlotte, NC.
As a Senior Retirement Income Product Manager, you’ll play a key role in Pacific Life’s growth and long-term success by leading efforts to drive Defined Contribution Lifetime Income (DCLI) and other Institutional Retirement Income strategies, connect market needs to retirement product roadmaps and collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to define and communicate the product vision, goals and roadmap based on market research and company objectives.

How you will make an impact:
· Lead efforts in defining institutional lifetime income product features and necessary documentation to facilitate knowledge transfer and development of requirements across project teams. Products can include annuity and retirement solutions proprietary to Pacific Life, or in collaboration with strategic partnerships.
· Collaborate with and influence various stakeholders including risk, pricing, legal, finance, sales, and operations.
· Ensure effective communication and alignment on retirement product initiatives and goals in preparation for any internal approval processes.
· Be viewed as the retirement product “expert” for all stakeholders across the division.
· In partnership with the project management function, drive the end-to-end product implementation process, including idea generation, requirements gathering, and product design to ensure seamless implementation.
· Coordinate with marketing and sales teams to plan and execute successful product launches, which includes effective product positioning, training materials and optimal sales support via product collateral and presentation deck updates. Be able to lead and/or support product training across various stakeholders.
· Conduct market research to identify customer needs, market trends. Gather insights to guide product development strategies.
· Monitor DCLI and retirement income competitive landscape broadly and create positioning and differentiators against competitors. Contribute to competitive intelligence updates.
· Identify retirement market needs by leveraging insights from the sales / relationship management / strategic partnership teams.
· Apply industry knowledge to drive product development strategies and identify market opportunities.
· Track product performance metrics, client feedback, and market response. Continuously evaluate product success and identify opportunities for improvement and enhancement. Report out on progress to senior leadership as needed.
· Partner with our Consumer Markets Division (CMD) to understand enterprise retirement product initiatives and determine areas of cross collaboration and information sharing, with the goal of creating economies of scale in the product development process.
· Represent Pacific Life’s Institutional Division at industry events and conferences.

The experience you will bring:
· Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, economics, or a similar field.
· Extensive knowledge of retirement solutions and annuities in the financial services industry, with a strong preference for Defined Contribution experience.
· Demonstrated 10-12 years of experience in product development and/or product management in the retirement/insurance/annuity industry.
· Ability to influence, partner and collaborate with divisional stakeholders.
· Strong desire for collaboration and a demonstrated ability to think creatively.

What will make you stand out:
· In depth knowledge of Defined Contribution plans, lifetime income product types and competitor landscape.
· Desire to stay up-to-date with retirement income trends, emerging technologies and regulatory changes that impact the insurance landscape.
· Experience with retirement plan advisors, plan sponsors and plan administrators.
· Finance, Actuarial, and/or Quantitative background, with an ability to create proof of concepts, business cases, and understand pricing and profitability.
· An agile mindset and the ability to demonstrate results in a start-up environment.
· Compelling presentation skills.
· Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to operate in ambiguity.
· Advanced degree, certifications and/or industry licensing (MBA, CFA, ASA/FSA, or other relevant education/designation/licensing).

#LI-TB1

Base Pay Range:

The base pay range noted represents the company’s good faith minimum and maximum range for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered to a candidate will be dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location. Also, most employees are eligible for additional incentive pay.

$152,010.00 - $185,790.00
Your Benefits Start Day 1

Your wellbeing is important to Pacific Life, and we’re committed to providing you with flexible benefits that you can tailor to meet your needs. Whether you are focusing on your physical, financial, emotional, or social wellbeing, we’ve got you covered.

- Prioritization of your health and well-being including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Wellbeing Reimbursement Account that can be used on yourself or your eligible dependents

- Generous paid time off options including: Paid Time Off, Holiday Schedules, and Financial Planning Time Off

- Paid Parental Leave as well as an Adoption Assistance Program

- Competitive 401k savings plan with company match and an additional contribution regardless of participation

You Can Be Who You Are

We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities. We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential.

jobs.title: Actuary & Director, Product and Pricing Risk, Workforce Benefits
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Pacific Life is investing in bright, agile and diverse talent to contribute to our mission of innovating our business and creating a superior customer experience. We’re actively seeking a talented Director of Product and Pricing Risk to join the Workforce Benefits Product and Pricing organization.

We are actively seeking a talented Actuary & Director, Product Pricing Risk on our Workforce Benefits team. This role is on-site 4 days per week and work from home 1 day per week in Newport Beach, CA, Omaha, NE, or Charlotte, NC. If you are not currently located near one of our offices, we offer comprehensive relocation assistance.

Our new Workforce Benefits division seeks to disrupt the group benefits market with a digital first strategy. As a Director of Product and Pricing Risk, you will support disciplined product and pricing decisions across the Workforce Benefits portfolio by leading cross-product analytics, governance, risk monitoring, and pricing capability development.  You will translate business priorities into practical pricing and risk frameworks, coordinate work across product lines, and provide recommendations and insights to Product and Pricing leaders. You will partner closely with pricing leadership, as well as colleagues in Underwriting, Finance, Sales, Enterprise Risk, Technology, and Operations. The role combines strong actuarial judgment, hands-on leadership, and the ability to drive execution through influence in a growing business. You will lead a small team and will work cross-functionally with division leadership and key partners in to develop leading edge risk management and market winning pricing strategies.

How you will make an impact:

- Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of cross-product pricing and risk processes, tools, and reporting that support consistent execution across Workforce Benefits products.

- Partner with Product and Pricing leaders to analyze new business and renewal results, evaluate emerging trends, and recommend adjustments to pricing approaches, profitability targets, and portfolio guardrails.

- Coordinate the development and maintenance of pricing tools, models, and reporting capabilities used by Pricing and Underwriting, including quoting tools, experience-rating support, quote monitoring, and management reporting.

- Build and maintain portfolio analytics that connect growth, profitability, competitiveness, and risk. Translate results into clear insights, options, and recommendations for business leaders.

- Facilitate cross-product assumption setting and documentation for items such as expenses, interest rates, profitability metrics, and other shared pricing inputs, in partnership with Finance, Pricing, and Product leadership.

- Establish and maintain practical monitoring standards, key performance indicators, thresholds, and escalation routines. Identify deviations and coordinate appropriate analysis and follow-up with accountable product-line leaders.

- Prepare clear, decision-ready materials for product, pricing, and risk governance forums. Coordinate reviews and approvals and ensure decisions, assumptions, and follow-up actions are documented.

- Provide actuarial and risk expertise on cross-functional initiatives involving underwriting practices, reinsurance, vendor or external-party risk, and new or enhanced product capabilities.

- Lead the cadence and prioritization of experience studies and other data-driven analyses in partnership with product pricing actuaries, ensuring findings are translated into actionable recommendations.

- Support month-end and quarter-end financial and reserving activities, as assigned, through analysis of claims experience, reserve movements, and key financial risk drivers.

- Lead and develop actuarial professionals and rotational analysts by setting clear priorities, reviewing work, strengthening technical capabilities, and creating meaningful development opportunities.

- Manage multiple initiatives in an evolving environment, escalating material issues and strategic trade-offs to the appropriate AVP or VP leader.   Support other projects as needed on a very nimble and collaborative team.

The experience you will bring:
- 8+ years of progressive actuarial experience with an FSA designation.

- Deep experience in group product lines (Dental, Vision, Group Life, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Supplemental Health, Leave and Absence Management).

- Experience managing multiple initiatives, working with ambiguity, and adapting to change.

- Experience developing or implementing pricing analyses, assumptions, monitoring frameworks, or governance processes. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to successfully influence across teams.

- Demonstrated leadership and interpersonal skills.

- Bachelor’s degree is preferred, or demonstrated experience.

What will make you stand out:
- Experience developing or implementing both new business and renewal pricing strategy

- Experience developing and implementing assumptions, monitoring frameworks, or governance processes.

- Digital and analytic mindset.

- Entrepreneurial energy and excitement to operate in a start-up environment.
